expected_invariant: what should have held (the falsifiability header invariant)
minimal_counterexample: the shrunk fast-check counterexample (parsed JSON when possible)
note: SCHEMA EXAMPLE — not a real regression. Real records are written by tests/_support/regression.js via withRegressionLedger. Duplicates are suppressed: the same (property, seed, path, counterexample) reuses the open record instead of minting a new id.
original_failure: the first 4000 chars of the failure message
ping_commit: git HEAD when the failure was recorded
